Agent Island v0.11.2 makes Codex quota status fresher and exposes the live snapshot to local integrations.

### What's new

- Rechecks known Codex session files about every 2.5 seconds while keeping recursive discovery on a slower schedule.
- Displays the optional Codex Credits balance and the quota update time in the usage tooltip.
- Includes the current agent quota snapshot in the loopback-only `/v1/state` response.
- Preserves filesystem-watch fallback behavior when Windows drops recursive events.

### Privacy

- Credits balance, quota, reset time, plan type, and context usage are read only from local Codex `token_count` records and held in process memory.
- The local `/v1/state` endpoint now includes that quota snapshot. It binds to `127.0.0.1`, but other programs running as the same Windows user may still call a loopback service.
- No new outbound network request, telemetry, analytics, or cloud account was added.
- Prompt text remains visible by default; reasoning content is not read.

### Windows download notice

The portable x64 build is not code-signed. Windows SmartScreen may show an “Unknown publisher” warning. Verify the accompanying `.sha256` file before running the executable, or build from source.

Please report bugs in Issues and share integration feedback in Discussions. Do not post private prompts, clipboard contents, notification text, tokens, account details, Credits balances, or local paths.
